title: Energizing Italian-Style Chinese Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and healthy twist on traditional Chinese cuisine, combining the flavors of Italy with the energizing properties of apples.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Italian parsley, tuscan seasoning, and diced apples to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the apples are tender.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the stracciatella.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the stracciatella is melted and the chicken is coated.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Italian parsley if desired.
